section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a study (referred to as 'The current study' or 'Study X') conducted with 135 British female undergraduates. The study investigated the relationships between gender ideology and body image, using the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) and the Femininity Ideology Scale (FIS). It reported negative correlations between body appreciation and FIS subscales, as well as respondent BMI, with a multiple linear regression explaining 10.0% of the variance in body appreciation.
